notes: The coin flip now shows the real result. The toss ran for a fixed time at a fixed speed, so it always landed on the same face — heads, every game, whether you won or lost. It now lands on heads when you win the flip and tails when you lose. (The flip itself was always a fair 50/50; only the animation was wrong.) The coin also has two sides now — gold heads, silver tails — with the metal changing as it turns, so it reads as a real two-sided disc. Turn order is colour-coded to match: on the keep-hand / mulligan screen the order pill is gold when you're going first and silver when you're going second.
